`AndroidManifest-io.appium.settings-220.xml` is the compiled (binary XML)
manifest of `settings_apk-debug.apk` from the npm package `io.appium.settings`
9.2.3 (Apache-2.0, https://github.com/appium/io.appium.settings). It is a real
aapt2 output used to test `scripts/lib/apk_manifest.py`
(package `io.appium.settings`, versionCode 220, versionName 9.2.3).
